title: O001-P1 Trial-Alignment Permutation Replication
purpose: Test whether O002's REAL_SIGNAL_BUT_NO_INCREMENT pattern generalizes to independent O001 EEG+autonomic trial data: real trial-aligned physiology should outperform category-matched misaligned physiology even when the frozen strong prior-report/context baseline is not improved.
evaluation: Leave-one-subject-out using the same held-out subjects as O001 primary.
baseline: target_code + music_id + immediately prior same-axis self-report

model.preprocessing: Exactly the O001 primary preprocessing: one-hot target_code/music_id; standardized prior; autonomic standardized; EEG standardized then PCA(20).
model.alpha_rule: Reuse each target×heldout-subject×modality alpha selected in the frozen O001 primary. No retuning after permutation.

null_control.type: within-subject × target_code circular permutation of the complete physiology vector
null_control.ordering: sort each subject×target_code group deterministically by run then onset then trial; circularly shift by a non-zero offset
null_control.vector_rule: All EEG and autonomic features are shifted together to preserve their multivariate covariance structure.
null_control.rationale: Preserves participant identity, coarse intended affect/target category, feature distributions and cross-modal covariance while breaking exact trial/music alignment.
null_control.limitation: music_id is effectively unique within participant in the frozen O001 table, so exact-stimulus identity cannot be preserved by a nontrivial within-participant permutation. A positive alignment contrast may therefore contain stimulus-specific as well as subjective-affect-specific physiology.

primary_quantity: For each held-out subject, target, and modality: mean over permutations [MAE(category-matched shifted physiology)-MAE(real trial-aligned physiology)]. Positive values favor real alignment.
uncertainty: 5000 paired subject bootstrap resamples for each target×modality primary contrast.

decision.EXTERNAL_REAL_SIGNAL_REPLICATION: At least the autonomic or combined modality has a primary CI strictly above zero for both valence and arousal, while its frozen O001 Ridge model did not establish increment beyond the strong baseline.
decision.PARTIAL_ALIGNMENT_REPLICATION: A primary CI is strictly above zero for some target/modality combinations but the both-axis external pattern is incomplete.
decision.NO_ALIGNMENT_REPLICATION: No target/modality primary CI is strictly above zero.
decision.SHIFTED_BETTER_ANOMALY: Any primary CI strictly below zero; investigate model/control mismatch without post-hoc rescue.

relation_to_o001_s1: O001-S1 nonlinear sensitivity found a small ExtraTrees valence increment. O001-P1 uses the frozen O001 Ridge primary only and must not erase or reinterpret that sensitivity.
firewall: Positive real-vs-shifted alignment does not establish causal physiology-to-feeling influence.
Because exact music identity cannot be preserved, alignment evidence may include stimulus-specific physiological structure.
No phenomenal identity or consciousness inference.
